stories.headline: EVs to make up over half of Singapore vehicle sales in 2026, BMI says
stories.summary: Electric vehicles are projected to make up more than half of all new car sales in Singapore by 2026, according to a report by BMI. While rapid infrastructure deployment has supported early adoption, the next phase of market expansion is expected to face greater challenges.

stories.headline: OneByZero raises US$20M Series A to help enterprises move AI from pilots to production
stories.summary: AI startup OneByZero has raised US$20 million in a Series A funding round to help enterprises transition their artificial intelligence pilots into full production. The company's platform is designed to help large, heavily regulated businesses in Southeast Asia deploy AI systems that comply with local regulations and integrate smoothly with existing workflows.

stories.headline: Why Southeast Asia’s AI coding race is moving from models to infrastructure
stories.summary: Southeast Asia's software engineering teams are shifting their focus from evaluating individual AI models to building the underlying infrastructure needed for AI-assisted coding. This transition prioritizes developer workflows, integration, and latency over simply comparing the raw performance of models like GPT-4 or Claude.

stories.headline: 👨🏿‍🚀TechCabal Daily – Jig is up for spam callers
stories.summary: Ghana has awarded 5G licenses to telecom operators MTN and Telecel to expand high-speed mobile connectivity in the country. Additionally, the Ghanaian government has introduced new regulations governing the public procurement of artificial intelligence technologies.

stories.headline: Stop calling Southeast Asia an emerging market in mobile. It is where the behaviour gets invented
stories.summary: ASEAN leaders are scheduled to sign the Digital Economy Framework Agreement (DEFA) in November, marking the first region-wide pact specifically designed for the digital economy. The agreement aims to streamline digital trade, cybersecurity, and digital payments across Southeast Asia, potentially unlocking up to $2 trillion in digital economy value by 2030.

stories.headline: Snapdeal Parent AceVector Lists At 11.6% Discount On BSE
stories.summary: AceVector, the parent company of Indian e-commerce platform Snapdeal, made a weak debut on the Bombay Stock Exchange, listing at an 11.6% discount at ₹28.30. The listing represents a significant transition for the company, which restructured its business after losing market share to larger e-commerce rivals.

stories.headline: Trump unveils 'Super Intelligence Force' to oversee AI policy
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump has announced the creation of a new taskforce called the 'Super Intelligence Force' to oversee artificial intelligence policy and coordinate federal engagement with AI companies. Led by Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton, the group aims to maintain US leadership in the technology and will include leaders from the Federal Trade Commission, Department of Defense, and Office of Personnel Management. This initiative follows a recent executive order renaming AI to 'Super Intelligence' within the federal government.
